changes: Integration setup keeps checking after sign-in, offers retry when a check fails, and opens external settings in your browser. Delayed replies cannot change a page or account you have left.
Opening app settings or retrying an integration setup now uses a fresh sign-in link instead of an expired or already-used link

While an episode is live, its conversation fragments — including finished ones and offline-sync captures — fold under the one live row in Today instead of showing as separate rows; they return as ordinary rows once the episode closes

Adding an MCP server that does not need sign-in now opens its page so you can enable it. Retrying a sign-in for an MCP server now starts a fresh authorization instead of reopening an expired link, and slow integration status checks no longer cut a connection short
Home no longer repeats Disconnected in a row under the title when the pendant disconnects; the pill at the top is the one place it shows
Keep live episode notes progressing when speech has no audio position, and preserve closed recaps while recordings finish processing
Live capture now explains when running notes are unavailable, keeps the previous episode accessible, and shows pending audio chunks clearly.
Conversations that never got an AI-chosen emoji now show a neutral chat bubble instead of a random or brain icon

changes.change: Your pendant keeps reconnecting after a lost connection or app restart, with lower scan battery use
People, paired devices and other saved lists are kept when you reopen the app instead of being cleared

changes: If a pendant voice answer stops arriving, the question now gives up on time and you can ask again right away
Home no longer shows an Open Previous Episode link above your recaps
Home no longer shows an error card when Daily Recaps fail to load; they reappear on the next refresh
Change plans in Japanese yen with accurate monthly and annual prices.
Keep recording from your Omi when many recordings are waiting to sync, with smoother background saving.
Recording durations no longer count pauses between consecutive chunks
Scrolling and reopening the app stay smoother while a large recording backlog syncs in the background.
The live transcript can show an on-device preview while you record, replaced by the final transcript shortly after
Home no longer shows the For you suggestions feed
Short unidentified live turns stay unnamed across reconnects instead of creating a new numbered speaker for each socket.
Fixed the pendant tutorial getting stuck after asking Omi a question, including when another chat is open or a question fails.
Speaker labels stay consistent across transcripts and review questions, and excess unidentified voices are grouped as Others.
